institutions.name: Eindhoven University of Technology (TU/e)
institutions.entity_note: Research university (WO). TU/e bachelor overview lists 16 bachelor programmes: 13 are fully English-taught and listed here; Biomedical Engineering and Medical Sciences and Technology (Dutch and English, Dutch-language first-year materials) and Scheikundige Technologie (bilingual) were excluded as only partly English; from 2027/28 the Chemical Engineering and Chemistry track is the fully English version and is listed. Master overview shows 42 entries = 24 master programmes + 18 'master's tracks' (tracks of an existing MSc, not listed separately); of the 24 programmes, Medical Engineering (partly Dutch, Dutch-proficiency requirement) and Science Education (Dutch-taught teacher training) were excluded, leaving 22 incl. the joint JADS master Data Science in Business and Entrepreneurship. Fees: 2027-28 institutional rate EUR 22,400 (bachelor and master) per TU/e fee page; Data Science (JADS) uses 2026-27 JADS tariff. Pre-master's not listed.

programs.name: BSc Applied Mathematics
programs.application_deadline: 1 May
programs.requirements_note: Non-EU/EEA applicants (incl. Turkey): Lise Diplomasi plus at least 4 USA College Board AP exams (required subjects/scores apply), OR Lise Diplomasi plus a completed first year (60 ECTS) at a YOK-accredited technical university in a relevant programme with GPA >= 3.0/4; French-school Lise holders need the French Baccalaureat General. Subject requirements (maths, physics/chemistry at VWO level) and the mandatory study-choice check apply. IELTS/TOEFL minimums apply per section (IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 21 on old scale). EUR 100 non-refundable application fee. Applications for Sept 2027 intake open 1 Oct 2026. Institutional fee 2027-28 EUR 22,400 (2026-27: EUR 18,600); transitional lower rates apply only to students who started earlier (e.g. EUR 19,200 in 2027-28 for 2025/26-2026/27 starters).
